scope: Waveform display and source start/end/loop range editing for imported audio clips
environment: Kvant, pinned CI image (Qt 6.12.0), docker --network none
verified_behaviors: Range persistence behind required feature clip-ranges-v1, written only when used; malformed, out-of-bounds and misplaced range fields are refused

One-shot and looped ranges render the selected source frames exactly from a launch at frame 13 for blocks of 1, 7 and 257 frames; length 0 plays to the end; an unresolved clip keeps its range and renders silence
Waveform peaks of a known ramp; peaks are computed on the GUI thread, cached per decoded clip and width, never in the render callback
Range edits refuse empty, reversed, out-of-file, fractional and NaN ranges and non-imported clips without history change; each valid edit is one Undo step
Exported audio of a soloed track: a 480-frame one-shot range followed by silence, and the looped range, sample by sample
Save/Open keeps ranges; a file that became shorter opens whole with a message; re-import resets the range

Actual offscreen keyboard edits of Start and End, pointer click on Loop, Undo; a layout check that audio-column rows stay inside their column (this caught an overlap where the range row covered the next track's Duplicate button)
limits: Source-rate playback only; no warping, fades or crossfades at range boundaries. Offscreen checks; native Wayland and physical output remain unqualified.
